lines.text: Settled in his palace, David tells Nathan the prophet he lives in a house of cedar while the ark stays in a tent.
God says He has moved about with a tent since Egypt and took David from the pasture to rule Israel.
God promises to raise up David's descendant, who will build a house for His Name, and He will remove His devotion as He did from Saul.
David sits before the LORD and asks who he is to be brought this far, saying God knows His servant.
David says God drove out famines and plagues for Israel and asks that Nathan's name be magnified forever.
